description: Replays a CSV file logged by LOGAN20, putting each row of the file back out as twenty voltages

params.text: Holds the replay where it is, and carries on from there when pressed again
One shot mode: the file is played through once
How fast the rows are played back
Reads the file from disk again

inputs.text: A pulse holds the replay where it is, or carries on from there
A pulse moves the replay on to the next row
A voltage setting how fast the rows are played back
A voltage chooses which row of the file is put out
A pulse reads the file from disk again

outputs.text: One of the twenty voltages from the row being replayed

notes: no voltage appears at the outputs until a file has been opened; OPEN a LOGAN CSV in the panel menu chooses the CSV file to replay
the red display is the time rate you set and the green display shows the rate actually applied, after the voltage at the rate CV input and its attenuator are taken into account
menu: OPEN a LOGAN CSV — chooses the CSV file to be replayed
LOGGING IMPORT SEPARATOR — sets the character that separates the values in a row of the file: comma, full stop, semicolon, vertical bar, TAB, ampersand, exclamation mark or question mark
